description: This source file implements Websockets data echo tests using libcurl. It includes functions for sending and receiving binary Websocket frames, dumping data for debugging, and a main function that sets up a Websocket connection and performs an echo test with size parameters specified via command-line arguments.

methods.name: void dump(const char * text,unsigned char * ptr,size_t size,char nohex)
methods.description: Outputs a hex and ASCII representation of given data buffer for debugging purposes.

methods.name: CURLcode send_binary(CURL * curl,char * buf,size_t buflen)
methods.description: Sends binary Websocket data via curl_ws_send and logs the operation.

methods.name: CURLcode recv_binary(CURL * curl,char * exp_data,size_t exp_len)
methods.description: Receives binary data over Websocket, verifying frame contents match expected data, and logs details.

methods.name: void websocket_close(CURL * curl)
methods.description: Sends a close frame to terminate the Websocket connection.

methods.name: CURLcode data_echo(CURL * curl,size_t plen_min,size_t plen_max)
methods.description: Performs a series of send and receive operations with incrementally increasing data length, testing Websocket data echo functionality.

ctags.name: data_echo
ctags.pattern: /^static CURLcode data_echo(CURL *curl, size_t plen_min, size_t plen_max)$/

ctags.name: dump
ctags.pattern: /^void dump(const char *text, unsigned char *ptr, size_t size,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * text,unsigned char * ptr,size_t size,char nohex)
